title: Reefer Cargo Services: Closure of a Reefer Service File
content:
After a Reefer Cargo Services container has been delivered, the service file is closed. Closure is carried out by the system, not by the desk, and it applies only to a service that has reached delivered.

## Clause

The system closes a delivered service. Closure does not shut the account to every entry: a remittance may still be applied, a goodwill waiver may still be granted on a fee that had already been booked, and an excursion credit may still be entered as long as it falls inside the reporting window.

## Entries on a closed file

| Kind of entry | Possible after closure? |
|---|---|
| Remittance against the charges | yes |
| Goodwill waiver of a fee already booked | yes |
| Excursion credit requested inside the reporting window | yes |

## Points of judgement

- A closed service is one that was delivered before it was closed; a service that never reached delivery is not closed by this route.
- The three kinds of entry above remain subject to their own conditions; closure neither adds to nor removes those conditions.
